evidence: Static read-only analysis; no app or judge run was needed or performed for this data row. The only shipped JSON/CSV/TSV data files are environment/assets/seed_data.json and solution/app/src/seed_data.json (plus package.json); both seed copies are byte-identical (SHA256 1b39015461a7a4f23b835aeea9584caffd0266c64d394778376cbd6c8a18bcf7, which equals the hash recorded for solution/app/src/seed_data.json in raw-evidence-index.json). The file parses as JSON, is LF-only, ASCII-only, no BOM. Referential integrity (scripted check over the parsed file): 3 employees, 7 users, 7 requisitions, 13 offers, no duplicate ids; every offer.req_id resolves to a requisition; every referred_by resolves to an employee and is null exactly when referred_hire_start is null; every approved_by/raised_by resolves to a user; every seed_commitments/seed_equity_grants/seed_remittances/seed_referral_accruals offer_id resolves and its req_id/referrer_id/candidate/referred_hire_start equal the parent offer. No orphans in the other direction: every employee and every requisition is referenced; each of the 8 COMMITTED offers has exactly one commitment, the one COMMITTED offer with equity (OFF-201) has a grant with identical units/strike/fair, both COMMITTED offers with a signing bonus (OFF-201, OFF-205) have a matching SIGNING remittance, both COMMITTED referred offers (OFF-110, OFF-111) have an accrual. Arithmetic: all 8 movement_cents equal -(base + annualized equity) per hireops_rules.md:123, e.g. OFF-201 17000000 + 7200*(2500-1000)/4 = 19700000 (seed_data.json:402). All approved_by users are approvers whose authority_tier meets the band of the offer basis (OFF-092 basis 21000000 Band II by tier 2; OFF-291 basis exactly 20000000 Band II by tier 3; OFF-201 basis 21700000 by tier 3). The constants block (seed_data.json:4-25) agrees with the published rules: band edges $200,000/$350,000 (rules:156-158), signing 40% cliff + 5%/month to 24 months, equity 20% cliff + 4%/month to 32 months (rules:314-327), referral $10,000 / 50% / 6 months (rules:337-342), reference moment 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z (seed:3, rules:60). Cleanliness: all emails use the reserved hireops.example domain and match the 7 accounts in instruction.md:19; no password, token, key, URL, phone, DOB or address appears in the seed (the demo password lives only in instruction.md, which the profile permits); 23 distinct plainly synthetic person names; every free-text note field is the empty string and generated_note (seed:2) is a benign provenance sentence, so there is no injection payload. Observations that are not defects: (a) stated_headroom_scalar_cents disagrees with budget + sum(movements) on all 7 requisitions (e.g. REQ-ENG-1 stated 25000000 vs derived 24000000, seed:97; REQ-ENG-4 stated 0 vs derived 15000000, seed:121). This is a deliberate, publicly disclosed trap: rules:178-179 say headroom is not a number stored on the requisition and rules:91-93 say imported old planning scalars are never financial authority, so it is not hidden inconsistency. (b) Some demonstration chronology is unusual but violates no stated rule: OFF-091/092/291/391 have approved_at after start_date, and PENDING OFF-101 has start_date 2026-01-01 before raised_at 2026-07-20 (seed:199-201). (c) OFF-DC is raised by an approver account, USR-APP2 (seed:342), which reads as an intentional separation-of-duties fixture. instruction.md:17 makes the operational rows optional demonstration history, so none of these can mis-grade a conforming build.
